_about: Copy and density budgets of docs/KNACK_UX.md section 5, as data for apps/dashboard/scripts/check-copy.mjs. docs/knack-ux/budgets.json is the spec's copy; this file is the one the script reads and adds the address of each screen. Measured the way docs/knack-ux/scripts/measure-clutter.mjs measures: words in visible text nodes of #main (SVG text included) inside the first viewport height; the sidebar is counted apart. Two windows apply (1440 by 900 on the web, 1152 by 735 in the desktop app); at 390 by 844 only words and paragraphs apply. A change that raises a number is a decision: send it to the lead, who records it in docs/DECISIONS.md.

evidence.why: D45: Evidence prints everything a reviewer needs. Only the sidebar rule, the header rule (no mono capitals outside axes) and the banned-word scan apply to it.

sidebar.note: labels, brand, name, Stop and one status line; a worker has the five destinations and no More; an admin has eight and More

rules.noEyebrow: an element with class t-label directly above the h1, repeating the sidebar label, is banned (the header is a title, one printed limit and the badge)
rules.noMonoCapitals: computed text-transform: uppercase on visible text in #main outside SVG (chart axes and the work ribbon draw their own text in SVG)

never_hidden: consent text and the equal weight of Not now and Never
It will never ... line on a routine
the consequence of an irreversible or outward step
errors, and what was not touched
limits (Measures help needed, not expertise; For coaching and onboarding, not for evaluating individuals)
the kill state and the glance-in-flight marker
n and the interval on Admin and Evidence screens

expanded.note:
An opened disclosure holds at most one short paragraph (a

of eight words or more) and label and value rows, and one row of actions; whatever else there is sits in one closed More inside it. Words count prose and rows: the labels drawn inside a chart (SVG text) do not, a chart being one object. 60 words is the spec's disclosure body (docs/KNACK_UX.md section 5); the paragraph number and the controls number (seven: one text field, its submit and one row of five example questions is the widest row an opened block may hold) are the owner's one-row rule of 8 Nov. Evidence is exempt (D45).
